quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on his mother's advice regarding career patience
quotes.excerpt: When it's my time, this and that and my mom was like, 'Don't worry, the man above got you.'
quotes.quote: I was talking to my mom yesterday. It was important in my career where a lot of my peers were getting offers, this and that, and we were young, so it didn't really matter when I look back at it. But I was just like, 'When is my time?' and my mom was like, 'Don't worry, the man above got you.' I kind of take that with anything in my life.
